title: pyrrocoma hirta var. sonchifolia
intro: Pyrrocoma hirta var. sonchifolia, commonly known as Sonchus, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Sonchus include analgesic, anti-spasmodic, and diuretic properties, making it useful for relieving pain, muscle spasms, and fluid retention. The bioactive constituents of Sonchus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
